name: EU Taxonomy — Activity 8.1: Data Centres
description: Technical screening criteria for data centres under Climate Change Mitigation objective

criteria.name: Waste heat reuse programme in place or assessed

climateAdaptation.label: Climate Change Adaptation
climateAdaptation.requirement: Physical climate risks assessed per IPCC RCP 4.5/8.5 scenarios

water.label: Water and Marine Resources
water.requirement: Water consumption monitored; water-efficient cooling in water-stressed areas

circularEconomy.label: Circular Economy
circularEconomy.requirement: Construction waste management plan; circular IT asset approach

pollution.label: Pollution Prevention and Control
pollution.requirement: No use of substances of very high concern (SVHC); refrigerant management plan

biodiversity.label: Biodiversity and Ecosystems
biodiversity.requirement: Environmental impact assessment for sites near protected areas

minimumSocialSafeguards.requirement: Alignment with OECD Guidelines for MNEs and UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights

scoringImpact.description: EU Taxonomy alignment materially improves Article 8/9 SFDR eligibility and green bond access
